scope: 7 representative list/shop/reveal boards; instructions only for parent normal UI execution

coordinateSpace.rects: absolute even when parent is set

executionRules: Use only normal UI actions; this file is not a saved model, tool schema, design import, or source edit.
Actions are ordered; every parent key refers to an earlier action.
Text remains native op:text, separate from image pixels and button skins. Numeric weights are used.
Buying, claiming and Go actions are sample navigation only; wire to prepared local sample confirmation/reward pages, never a live purchase.
Do not display screenshot frames/crops as production. All path/region images are prepared assets.
Repeated cards share identical dimensions by role. Resource/glyph substitutes and omitted repeated rows are explicitly listed in each family notes.

families.name: Page_ACE_PilotList
families.purpose: Pilot collection: nine equal cards, observed first six level labels, filter and amplification affordance.
notes: Nine freshly generated portrait cells are reference-inspired approximations, not confirmed character identities.
Source steampunk wall is approximated by a flat brown root because a matching clean backdrop is unavailable.
Original rarity badges, ability sub-icons and global icon navigation are omitted; first six level labels are retained. Third-row labels are behind the source bottom tabs and omitted.
Pilot/Pappo selector is drawn as the observed native caption strip; Pappo content is unobserved and must not be fabricated.
